name: Akatsuki Inc.
summary: Akatsuki Inc. engages in the entertainment, lifestyle, and solutions businesses in Japan and internationally. The company is involved in the planning, development, and operation of mobile games under the Dragon Ball Z Dokkan Battle and Romancing SaGa names, as well as vertical-scrolling full-color comics; development and operation of mobile devices; and management of multiple brands of sweets shops. It also provides online lottery sales systems under the SlashGift_ name; and develops and operates fan app platforms.
